name: Switch
description: Flip a light and its neighbours until the whole board is dark.
hint: Click, or ←↑↓→ and Space, to flip · ⌘Z undo · R new board
whatsNew: How to play, hints and Give up.

rules: Pressing a light flips it and the four lights next to it (up, down, left, right).
Par is the number of presses the board was made with; the best solution is never longer.
